_note: Source for the program pages. Edit here, then run `npm run programs` and `npm run search`. Course lists must match programs.html and tuition must match its fee table; the tests check both. Fees follow TIME Inc.'s approved fee schedule (US$1 = LRD 170).

programs.name: "C" Certificate in Elementary Education
programs.summary: Prepares elementary teachers in core subject areas and professional pedagogy.
programs.lead: An accredited teacher-training certificate that helps elementary teachers and subject specialists become skilled, ethical, professional classroom teachers.
programs.imageAlt: TIME Inc. graduates in black gowns and 2026 stoles walking in the graduation procession
facts: Register by January 4, 2027 · classes begin March 8, 2027
Bureau of Teacher Education, Ministry of Education
who: Elementary school teachers who have not yet had formal teacher training
Subject specialists who know their subject and want to learn how to teach it
School staff preparing for an accredited teaching qualification
learn: Teaching methods for each subject area
programs.feeAnswer: Tuition is US$80 (LRD 13,600) for the full nine-month program, paid in two equal installments of US$40 (LRD 6,800): the first when you register and the second before the exit examination. A registration fee of US$15 may apply, and the exit examination fee is US$10 (LRD 1,700).

programs.feeAnswer: The tuition fee for this program is confirmed by the administration before registration, so please contact admissions. A registration fee of US$15 may apply, and the exit examination fee is US$10 (LRD 1,700).
